title: MapleStory Idle RPG Guide Quest Progression
author: MapleStory Idle RPG Wiki contributors
summary: A progression reference for the Guide Quest chain, which unlocks major systems, equipment slots, content, and account conveniences as the character advances.

sections.title: Why Guide Quests matter
items: Guide Quests are a primary route for unlocking systems and content.
A blocked feature may require a later Guide Quest rather than a separate purchase.

sections.title: Unlock tracking
items: Track the current quest number and its required action.
Review future unlocks before spending resources around a locked system.

sections.title: Common dependencies
items: Equipment slots, nickname changes, currencies, and new content can be progression-gated.
Finish prerequisite quests before diagnosing a feature as missing.

notes: Community-wiki facts are clearly labeled and should be rechecked after patches.
steps: Verify newly unlocked systems before continuing.
recommended_stats: Combat Power appropriate for the current chapter
